_comment: Tool roles of the ASIC flow (docs/spec/asic-flow.md): Design Compiler and Formality. `q3tui tools init` copies them into the project's config/tools.json, where they are yours to edit.

asic_synth.description: Synopsys Design Compiler: the Tcl script Q3TUI writes (read RTL + SDC, compile_ultra, netlist, area / timing / power reports)

asic_lec.description: Synopsys Formality: RTL (reference) against the netlist (implementation); the script is written by Q3TUI
